h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambalpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sambalpur

c: Sambalpur summers are among the hottest in Odisha, and the Hirakud reservoir nearby brings humid air once the monsoon arrives. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to Sambalpur for parks, schools, the university and residential colonies, from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away by road.

Heat is the main thing we plan around here. Machines in full afternoon sun get uncomfortable, and paint on cheap steel tends to peel. Our frames are galvanised pipe and many contact parts are roto-moulded plastic, which stays cooler than bare metal. We suggest siting the gym where trees give shade in the morning and evening, when people actually use it. Installation is by our team or a dealer in eastern India, on a grouted base or a self-standing frame depending on the ground.

richText.heading: Siting an open gym for the Sambalpur heat

c: Walk the site at seven in the morning and again at five in the evening, and note where shade falls. That is where the stations should go. If the ground is open, a simple shed or a row of trees planted along one side will help in a few years.

items.q: Where should an outdoor gym go on a hot site?
items.a: Where shade falls in the early morning and evening, which is when most people exercise. Trees or a light shed over the stations help a great deal.

items.q: Does the heat damage the machines?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the moulded parts are made for outdoor use, so sun and heat do not cause rust. Moving parts should be checked and lubricated as per our maintenance advice.

items.q: Can three people use one machine together?
items.a: Yes, on three-way machines such as the Twister Three Way, which has three separate stations on one frame. Each person works at their own pace without affecting the others.
